messages:
Raj Patel: Hey team — quick heads up about next week’s all‑hands (Thu 10am PT). Short format this time: 35 minutes total. Please drop 1–2 bullets if you want something covered. Agenda draft below.

Raj Patel: Agenda (rough):
• 5m — company state + hiring snapshot
• 7m — Dedicated launch callouts & SLAs (product)
• 8m — runtime perf wins + cost optimization highlights (eng)
• 7m — customer story & Qs (CS)
• 8m — open Q&A (collected + live)

Raj Patel: Please add any pull requests or slides to the shared folder: https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/fall-slate (one‑pager preferred).

Emily Wong: Quick logistics — hybrid room A + Zoom. We'll have live captions. If you need closed captions in other languages, DM me. :white_check_mark:

Marco Ruiz: I can do a 90s demo of the Dedicated autoscale change — will slot into the "Dedicated launch callouts" section.

Priya Singh: Will the session be recorded? I want to check a bullet before it goes public.

Clara Gomez: Recording will be on by default. We'll post the recording and a trimmed 3‑min clip in #all-hands-posts after. If you want a segment removed, plz flag before EOD Thu.

Dave Li: One request from eng — can we include a single slide with the perf numbers + a short note on rollback plan? Helps on-calls and product teams.

Raj Patel: Yes — Dave, can you and Marco coordinate on that slide? Keep it to one chart + 1 line of rollback steps.

Marco Ruiz: Yup. I'll paste a draft slide by Tues COB.

Emily Wong: Also: snack box options for in-office folks — choose by Wednesday: tinyurl.com/redwood-snacks (lol).

Priya Singh: Thanks — noted re: flagging content. I’ll DM Clara with the segment I want held.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder scheduled — "All-Hands: Thu 10am PT" will post 24 hours and 1 hour before the event.

Clara Gomez: For Q&A collection, use this short form (we'll surface top items): https://forms.reddoc/allhands-questions — drop anything high priority by Wed 5pm.

Raj Patel: Targeting to keep the tone tight — no slides longer than 60s except the product demo. If anyone needs more time, ping me + your manager.

Priya Singh: One last ask — will the exec update include any policy changes? Need to know if we should prep comms for teams.

Raj Patel: Not a full policy rollout. We'll call out a minor update to deployment review process and link to the draft policy. If that looks good we’ll follow with comms next week.

Clara Gomez: Got it — I'll draft a 1‑paragraph internal note to attach to the recording post.

Dave Li: Noted. Will add the rollback bullet to the slide.

Marco Ruiz: Slide + demo link will be in the folder by Tue.

Raj Patel: Thanks all — please keep asks concise. See you Thu. :rocket:
